_ruleExplore_comment: ⑧ 批量预取模板（用 ajaxAll 并发 60 个详情）

ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
var MAX = 60;
var ids = [];
var re = /href="\/book\/(\d+)"[^>]*>([^<]{1,80})<\/a>/g;
var m, seen = {};
while ((m = re.exec(String(src))) !== null) {
  if (seen[m[1]]) continue;
  seen[m[1]] = true;
  ids.push({id: m[1], name: m[2].trim()});
}

var urls = ids.slice(0, MAX).map(o => "https://example.com/api/detail?id="+o.id);
var books = [];
if (urls.length > 0) {
  try {
    var resps = java.ajaxAll(urls);
    for (var j=0; j<resps.length; j++) {
      try {
        var d = JSON.parse(String(resps[j].body()));
        if (d && d.name) {
          books.push({
            name: d.name, author: d.author||"",
            bookUrl: "https://example.com/api/detail?id="+(d.id||ids[j].id),
            coverUrl: d.cover||"", intro: (d.intro||"").slice(0,100),
            kind: d.category||"", wordCount: d.wordCount||""
          });
        }
      } catch(e){}
    }
  } catch(eAll){ java.log("ajaxAll error: "+eAll); }
}
/* 兜底：接口失败时用页面裸数据 */
if (books.length === 0) {
  for (var k=0; k<ids.length && k<MAX; k++) {
    books.push({name: ids[k].name, author:"", bookUrl:"https://example.com/api/detail?id="+ids[k].id,
      coverUrl:"", intro:"", kind:"", wordCount:""});
  }
}
result = JSON.stringify(books);
</js>

var full  = String(java.getString('$.intro')||"").replace(/<br\s*\/?>/g,"\n").replace(/</g,"<").replace(/>/g,">").replace(/&/g,"&").replace(/ /g," ");

_ruleToc_comment: ⑩ 目录：缓存 + preUpdateJs 登录态自检 + 章节名智能组装

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
try {
  var params = unpackDataUrl(baseUrl);
  var bookId = params.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1];
  var token  = params.match(/token=([^&]*)/)[1];
  var useT   = /^\d+_[\w\d]{16,}/.test(token);
  var cacheKey = useT ? "tokToc_"+bookId : "toc_"+bookId;
  var src = cache.get(cacheKey);
  if (!src) {
    var url = "https://example.com/api/chapterList?bookId="+bookId+"&whole=1";
    if (useT) url += "&token="+token;
    src = String(java.ajax(url));
    cache.put(cacheKey, src, 300);
  }
  result = src;
} catch(e){ java.log(e); }
</js>

ruleToc.chapterName:
<js>
$=result;

var type  = $.type == '1';   // 1=卷标
var intro = $.intro||"";
java.put("intro1", intro);
var prefix = type ? '📖 ' : (vip ? '🔒 ' : '');

ruleToc.preUpdateJs:
<js>
try {
  var params = unpackDataUrl(book.tocUrl);
  var oldToken = (params.match(/token=([^&]*)/)||["",""])[1];
  var bookId = params.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1];
  var newToken = getHdr('token');
  if (/^\d+_[\w\d]{16,}/.test(newToken)) {
    var src = java.ajax("https://example.com/api/chapterList?bookId="+bookId+"&whole=1&token="+newToken);
    cache.put("tokToc_"+bookId, src, 300);
    var msg = String(JSON.parse(src).message || "");
    if (/登入验证失败|token失效|1004/.test(msg)) {
      setHeaders("token=");
      java.longToast("登录已失效，请重新登录");
      java.refreshTocUrl();
    } else if (newToken !== oldToken) {
      java.refreshTocUrl();
    }
  }
} catch(e){ java.log(e); }
</js>

_ruleContent_comment: ⑪ 正文：三态解密（JSON正常 / JSON错误 / 纯密文） + payAction

ruleContent.content:
<js>
function safeStr(v){ return String(v||""); }

try {
  var url = safeStr(baseUrl);
  var body = "";

  /* 兼容旧 data: URL 缓存 */
  if (/^data:/i.test(url)) {
    var params = unpackDataUrl(url);
    var realUrl = "https://example.com/api/chapterContent?" + params;
    var resp0 = java.get(realUrl, {});
    body = safeStr(resp0.body());
    if (isRawCipher(body)) body = decryptFromHeader(body, resp0.header("accesskey"), resp0.header("keystring")) || body;
  } else {
    body = safeStr(result);
    if (isRawCipher(body)) {
      var resp = java.get(url, {});
      var raw = safeStr(resp.body());
      if (isRawCipher(raw)) body = decryptFromHeader(raw, resp.header("accesskey"), resp.header("keystring")) || raw;
      else body = raw;
    }
  }

  var json = null; try { json = JSON.parse(body); } catch(e){}

  if (json) {
    var content = safeStr(json.content);
    var message = safeStr(json.message);
    if (content.length > 30) {
      try {
        out = String(java.createSymmetricCrypto("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding", "KEY_HERE", "IV_HERE").decryptStr(content)).trim();
      } catch(e){
        out = "❀ 解密失败："+e+"\n请重新登录后再试";
      }
    } else if (message) {
      var token = getHdr("token");
      var hasT = /^\d+_[\w\d]{16,}/.test(token);
      if (hasT) out = "🔒 " + message + "\n\n请通过书源菜单的「购买」按钮解锁本章";
      else out = "🔒 " + message + "\n\n请先登录后再试";
    } else {
      out = "❀ 响应中没有正文：\n" + body.slice(0, 200);
    }
  } else if (body.length > 100) {
    out = "❀ 响应无法解析：\n" + body.slice(0, 200);
  } else {
    out = "❀ 响应为空，请检查网络";
  }
} catch(e){
  out = "❀ 解析异常："+e;
}
out
</js>

variableComment:
【晋江技术复刻模板】
1. 替换 example.com 为目标站点域名
2. 替换 KEY_HERE / IV_HERE 为反编译得到的 DES 密钥
3. 替换 JSONPath（$.items[*] / $.name 等）为目标站点的实际字段
4. 替换搜索/详情/目录/正文的 API URL
5. 删除不需要的字段（如果站点不收费，可删除 payAction）
6. 如果站点无扫码，可删除 toScan() 和 loginUi 里的扫码按钮
7. 首次导入后实测：登录 → 搜索 → 详情 → 目录 → 正文 → 购买（按需）
